title: observability: add strobe telemetry and cost-synthesizer for burst attribution
author: Maya Chen
description:
Summary: Introduce a lightweight high-frequency 'strobe' telemetry stream plus a nightly 'cost-synthesizer' job that correlates kernel-queue timing, batch boundaries, and per-token emit markers to produce reconstructed per-invocation token pacing and synthetic token-cost attributions.
Motivation: We frequently see noisy long-tail burst events where traditional span sampling misses fine-grained token pacing and queue contention signals, making SLO root cause difficult. The strobe stream captures sub-span micro-timing without full payloads and the synthesizer aggregates these signals with model metadata to estimate token-level cost signatures for low-cardinality customers and synthetic traces for dashboards.
Design:
- Strobe agent: per-invocation micro-metrics (micro-latency, queue-depth-sample, batch-id hash, partial-kv-notes) emitted at tunable frequency and routed to observability ingestion topic with PII-stripping and rate-limits.
- Cost synthesizer: a batch job that pulls strobe events + kernel queue histograms + model catalog entries; applies heuristic correlator to assign token-phase ownership (decode, kv-lookup, kernel-wait) and emits synthetic spans and a compact cost signature per invocation.
- Dashboard: "Strobe Explorer" in Observability Console with swimlane view (burst lanes), token-phase stacked bars, and an aggregated cost fingerprint per tenant.
- Alerting: new alert "burst-surge-squelch" that uses strobe-derived burst-rate plus synthesized cost change to suppress noisy per-token alerts and instead escalate on sustained cost-pressure.
Privacy and safety: strobe stream intentionally omits prompt/response payloads and only uses hashed route/model ids; synthesizer outputs are aggregated and sampled to avoid exposing individual tokens.
Changes:
- runtime/strobe_agent: new agent + feature flag with opt-in by tenant.
- telemetry/ingest: small schema additions (micro_ts, batch_id_hash, phase_hint) and new low-cardinality index.
- pipelines/cost_synthesizer: new job with deterministic correlator, unit tests and integration harness.
- observability/ui: add strobe explorer panels and a config UI for strobe sampling and alert thresholds.
- alerting/rules: add burst-surge-squelch, update alert suppression flow.
Testing & rollout:
- Unit tests for correlator and end-to-end integration tests with synthetic replaybench.
- Canary rollout: opt-in tenants first (10%), then gradual ramp to 50% with monitoring on ingest QPS and CPU.
- Rollback path: feature flag disables strobe agent and stops the synthesizer job.
Impact & follow-ups: expect ~3-6% increased telemetry ingress for canaried tenants; estimated 0.8% query-cost from synthesizer runs when fully enabled. Follow-ups include migrating correlator to a learned model (ENG-8203) and adding a tenant-facing cost-explorer API.
Checklist:
- [x] Strobe agent implemented behind feature flag
- [x] Correlator unit tests
- [x] Integration replaybench tests
- [x] Dashboard panels and runbook
- [x] Alert rule and suppression mapping
- [x] Docs and privacy note

telemetry: extend ingest schema with micro_ts/batch_id_hash/phase_hint
ui: add Strobe Explorer dashboard panels
alerting: add burst-surge-squelch rule and suppression logic
docs: add strobe design and privacy considerations
review_comments: Arjun Patel: Nice work. Two asks: (1) ensure the strobe frequency defaults to 1 sample per 32 tokens to limit cardinality; (2) add a CI load test for the ingestion path. Please also document the privacy reasoning.
Author (Maya Chen): Addressed frequency default and added ingestion load test in ci/integration. Expanded privacy-notes.md to cover hashing and sampling. PTAL.
Lena Ortiz: Correlator seems brittle on tiny batch sizes. Suggest falling back to a probabilistic attribution when batch-size < 4. Added a comment and a test case. Approved after green CI.
release_notes: Add opt-in high-frequency strobe telemetry and nightly cost-synthesizer to produce reconstructed per-invocation token pacing and synthetic token-cost attributions. Includes new Strobe Explorer dashboard and burst-surge-squelch alert. Feature gated and opt-in.
